exercises.question: What is the correct imperfecto of 'comer' for 'ellos'?

exercises.sentence: Cuando era estudiante, Ana _____ (vivir) en Madrid.
exercises.english: When she was a student, Ana lived in Madrid.

exercises.sentence: Mis amigos y yo _____ (comer) juntos cada día.
exercises.english: My friends and I ate together every day.

exercises.sentence: Tú siempre _____ (beber) café por la mañana.
exercises.english: You always drank coffee in the morning.

exercises.sentence: De niño, yo comiba muchos dulces.
exercises.solution: De niño, yo comía muchos dulces.
exercises.explanation: -ER imperfecto ending is -ía, not -iba. Only -AR verbs use -aba.

exercises.sentence: Cuando vivía en Madrid, comía en ese restaurante.
options: When I lived in Madrid, I used to eat at that restaurant.
When I live in Madrid, I will eat at that restaurant.
I lived in Madrid and ate at home yesterday.
I want to live in Madrid and eat tapas.
